_note: Real, sourced token supply per capability lane. Tokens in BILLIONS. 'organic' = naturally-occurring text; 'trainable_frac' = fraction of tokens that carry loss (agentic traces are mostly masked context/observations). Indic carries a 4-tier label. Numbers are from the Session-5 inventory widget, our Assignment-3 research sweeps, and public dataset cards; each row cites its source. Conservative where a range exists.

datasets.name: The Stack v2 (dedup, Software Heritage)
datasets.source: Session inventory: ~600M files / ~900B tokens; StarCoder2 arXiv 2402.19173

reasoning_traces.note: Long chain-of-thought at graded depth. High/ultra depth is NOT freely available; must be distilled from a reasoning teacher.

agentic.note: Tokens are huge but loss is only on assistant tokens; tool outputs/observations are masked context. Real supply is tiny -> this lane is generation-heavy (distill from Claude/Codex traces + our own cloud-code sessions + simulated tool environments).

datasets.name: ToolBench
datasets.source: Session inventory: 120k examples / 80M tokens; multi-tool over real REST APIs

datasets.name: SWE-bench trajectories / terminal traces
datasets.source: scarce; real GitHub patches + shell sessions

datasets.name: Distilled/self-collected agent traces (to generate)
datasets.source: GENERATED: Claude/Codex distill + cohort cloud-code sessions + simulated envs

long_context.note: Each SAMPLE must be long (4K->32K+), trained at length (not truncated). Organic long samples are scarce -> up-sample long docs + synthesize via multi-doc packing and long agent trajectories.

datasets.name: Synthetic long (multi-doc packing / long traces)
datasets.source: GENERATED: concatenate related docs; long agentic trajectories

indic.note: 12 Assignment-3 languages. Split across four tiers because most Indic mass is NOT organic. Full Indic conversational would need ~2T tokens (unavailable) -> repetition + translation + synthesis.

verified.name: indic-align (our A4-cleaned)
verified.source: Assignment-4 pipeline output (MuRIL-counted; overlaps Sangraha family)

synthetic.name: Sangraha-Synthetic
synthetic.source: WikiMedia MT to 14 langs + romanized transliteration
